subject: New demo booked
body:
ID: 315 - Michaela Imhof (m.a.imhof@uva.nl) from University of Amsterdam on 2024-10-07
Topic: The research project aims at collecting EMA data from older adults and people with Parkinson's disease. We would like to use the app to send morning and evening questionnaires on a fixed schedule and also send randomised beeps throughout the day for 14 days.
In our research we want to assess the activities that older people carry out on a regular basis. Additionally, we investigate how Parkinson's medication have an effect on mood and motivation throughout the day. Older adults serve as a control group to account for natural mood fluctuations.
